back: A medicine of water mixed with other substances, believed to turn German bullets into water.
A district official in German East Africa who collected taxes and labour and was often accused of abuse.

front: When did the Maji Maji uprising take place?
back: From July 1905 to 1907, in southern German East Africa.
The spirit medium who taught the maji belief; hanged by the Germans in August 1905.

front: Name two causes of the Maji Maji uprising.
back: Forced cotton growing and taxes (also forced labour and abuse by akidas).

front: What was the estimated death toll of the uprising?
back: Estimates range from about 75,000 to well over 200,000, mostly from famine and disease.

front: How did the Germans defeat the uprising?
back: With machine guns, reinforcements and scorched earth, which caused famine.

front: Why was the maji belief both a strength and a weakness?
back: It united peoples and gave courage, but it did not stop bullets.

front: What was the legacy of the Maji Maji?
back: German reforms from 1907 and a memory of unity used by later nationalists.
